verdict.rationale: Ramp documents AI-driven GL coding of transactions (auto-categorization on card swipe, automatic invoice coding to GL account) and bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries, which supports accelerated close. However, evidence does not explicitly address multi-entity handling or cross-entity GL assignment specifically, and lacks independent/hands-on verification of accuracy at scale. Missing for 10: explicit multi-entity GL coding evidence, third-party validation of AI coding accuracy, and close-acceleration metrics.
